nodes.label: role-updates Topic (UPSERT)
nodes.rationale: Consumer synthesises UPSERT_ROLE from topic name; operation field is never on the wire to prevent wire-level ambiguity (Consequence C9)

nodes.label: Derived Operation from Topic Pattern
nodes.rationale: The operation is never on the wire; the consumer synthesises UPSERT_ROLE or DELETE_ROLE from the topic name, eliminating wire-format ambiguity

nodes.label: Health Indicator (mode inconsistency)
nodes.rationale: Java emits mode as upper-case (NORMAL, SEED); NestJS emits lower-case (normal, seed). This is a known cross-language inconsistency.

nodes.label: AuthzAutoConfiguration Class
nodes.rationale: Auto-configuration with @ConditionalOnMissingBean so consumers can override any SPI implementation without forking the library

nodes.label: Global Enforcement Pattern (no per-route opt-in)
nodes.rationale: Enforce authorization at a single choke point so no route ships unprotected by omission; prevents per-route opt-in gaps

nodes.label: Cross-Language Parity Standard
nodes.rationale: Both implementations (Java/Spring, TypeScript/NestJS) must pass identical language-neutral test vectors; never tweak a vector to make one language pass
